messages:
Alice Morgan: Heads-up — we need to shift the cutover by +25m. Can owners confirm smoke & rollback readiness? original window 23:00 UTC.
Ben Kaur: Ack. I can cover smoke for api-green lane. Will run burn-in + perf checks.
Carol Li: I can be rollback owner. Where's the latest rollback script?
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot: scheduled change: canary toggle at 23:25 UTC -> 1 host -> alert channel #eng-sre.
Dave Ortiz: Carol, rollback script is at repo: `infra/rollbacks/cutover-2026-03.sh` — please verify creds. Quick undo snippet: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=2```
Erin Patel: I will do DB guardrails. No schema change but I'll run read-only smoke for prod tables at +5m after canary.
Alice Morgan: Quick checklist: 1) owners ack 2) smoke playbook loaded 3) rollback tested 4) on-call aware 5) metric alerts green. @deploy-bot please post the runbook link.
Ben Kaur: Ack checklist items 1-5 for api-green. Smoke script: `scripts/smoke/burnin.sh` — runs 3 reqs/min for 2m.
Carol Li: Rollback script tested in staging — two dry-runs successful. I'll be ready to cut at 23:30 if needed.
Dave Ortiz: Canary plan: start 5% -> 25% over 10m. Watch p95 latency, error-rate, and token throughput. Dash: `redwood.console/canary/api-green`.
Erin Patel: On-call: @Dave Ortiz and @Ben Kaur primary. I will cover DB alerts. Paging policy unchanged.
Alice Morgan: If everyone's ack, I'll push updated schedule + runbook to the calendar and post final go/no-go at t-minus-10m.
Ben Kaur: :thumbsup: ACK
Carol Li: :white_check_mark: ROLLBACK READY
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot: runbook link: https://docs.internal/runbooks/cutover-3099990001 — confirm receipt.
Alice Morgan: Received. Final ask: devex please keep code review pings quiet during rollout (no mass merges). I'll send a banner to #general.
Dave Ortiz: Noted. Will also mute non-critical alert noise for the window.
Erin Patel: All set from DB side. Ping me if anything spikes.
Alice Morgan: Thanks all — will post t-minus-10m in ~15m.
